gameDescriptionHtml:
Galaia is a small Action-Adventure Roguelite made with love for both roguelite fans and newcomers to the genre!

Centuries have passed since The Flood destroyed the mighty kingdom of Galaia. Atop of the wreckage, only the Last Ruins remain, and among them the answers to what happened.

Venture time and time again into the ever-changing ruins of Galaia defeating enemies, exploring enigmatic locations, and uncovering secrets until you collect all the powerful Relics hidden inside!

Game Features

  • A Cozy Roguelite: Galaia is very welcoming to newcomers to the genre while still offering challenges to the most veteran roguelike players.
  • Fast and Fun Combat: Galaia’s combat is straight up shooter fun, very focused on mobility and synergies.
  • More Than Meets the Eye: Not everything is combat! The mysterious ruins hide many secrets and collectibles.
  • Come and Join the Adventure! What are you waiting for? Galaia awaits!
